Seattle Sounders FC @ Sporting Kansas City

Sunday, September 27, 2015

Kickoff: 4PM CT / 2PM PT

Sporting Park

Kansas City, KS

By Woody Favinger

There's a scene in Breaking Bad where Walter White finally verbalizes his full transformation into Drug-Kingpin-Badass. He finishes a chilling monologue to his wife with, "No, you clearly don't know who you're talking to, so let me clue you in. I am not in danger, Skyler. I am the danger. A month ago we were in danger. The playoff door was beginning to close. Hopes were down. Tensions were high. Hamstrings were strained. Not now. Now, we are the danger.

We just crushed the Whitecaps in back to back games by a combined score of (approximately) 47-0. After a couple months where no one could score, now everyone is scoring. Ivanshitz, Pineda, Oba, Neagle, Barrett/Valdez (couldn't we have just given them both credit for that goal?). Take notice, MLS.

Sunday, we'll knock on Kansas City's door, a place renowned for its barbeque and consistently conceding stoppage time game winners to Seattle. A place otherwise so inconsequential that no one really knows (or cares) whether it's located in Kansas, or Missouri... or both? To be fair, most people probably can't point out Kansas and Missouri on a map either. Hashtag flyover states.

The team formerly known as the Wiz are fast approaching the time when they should #Start2Panic, after losing five of their last seven, most recently dropping to 10-man Houston. Oh, and Besler and Feilhaber were apparently so terrified of having to face Obadeucevaldvanshitz that they picked up yellow card suspensions. Oops! They're in danger and they know it.

All season long, even during the dark days, we knew that at full strength we were the best team in MLS. Then during the summer transfer window we got better. Now we're healthy and we're at our best.

We are not in danger.

We are the danger.

Be scared, Kansas City, the Sounders are knocking.
